traffic_characteristics: SCTP association established at frames 1-4 and shut down at frames 26-28
No N3 (GTP-U) and no N4 (PFCP) traffic is present in the capture

limitations: No 5GSM layer identity is decodable anywhere in the capture: nas-5gs.sm.message_type and the 5GSM cause fields return no value for any of the 28 frames, so neither a PDU Session Establishment Reject nor an unsupported-DNN cause can be observed
Frames 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21 expose nas-5gs.security_header_type 2 or 4 with only nas-5gs.ciphered_msg present, so no NAS-5GS message type is decodable at those frames
UplinkNASTransport and DownlinkNASTransport are NGAP (TS 38.413) message identities; the NAS-5GS layer contributes no message identity at those frames

The protected N2 exchange continues after frame 18 with a downlink at frame 19, an uplink at frame 20 and a downlink at frame 21, so no single downlink transport can be identified as a terminal reject
Absence of NGAP procedure code 29 (PDUSessionResourceSetup) inside the captured N2 window is an absence of evidence, not a packet-visible rejection
The NGAP UEContextReleaseRequest at frame 22 reports Cause radioNetwork (radio-connection-with-ue-lost); that RAN-side transport observation does not prove a core-side session rejection or its cause
Capture contains no N4 (PFCP) and no N3 (GTP-U) traffic, so absence of a PFCP session cannot support a rejection finding
Resolving this case requires either a capture whose NAS security context is derivable, or the decoded inner 5GSM message type and cause supplied as independent packet evidence
revision_reason: Revision 3, independent raw-capture adjudication of captures/fault-injection/unsupported-dnn/fault.pcap (sha256 fa8daf46694594f0ff007eca49a3ebe5e1ca54d14f6784e9000c11d6b77112a8) with TShark 4.7.1. Previous claim: analysis_status BOUNDARY_OBSERVED with a DERIVED first abnormal boundary at frame 18, NGAP DownlinkNASTransport in 5gc-pdu-session pdu_session_establishment, read as an unsupported-DNN rejection derived from the protected downlink NAS transport plus the absence of any N2 resource setup. Corrected claim: analysis_status INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with no first abnormal boundary, because that derivation is not supported by the packet evidence. Frame 18 exposes only ngap.procedureCode 4 with nas-5gs.security_header_type 2 and no decodable NAS-5GS payload; no 5GSM message type or cause is exposed by any frame in the capture; the protected exchange does not terminate at frame 18 but continues through frames 19, 20 and 21; and the only later abnormal-looking event, the UEContextReleaseRequest at frame 22, carries the RAN-side cause radio-connection-with-ue-lost. A protected NAS envelope plus an absent PDUSessionResourceSetup therefore cannot prove a specific PDU Session Reject or its Cause, and no precise abnormal frame is invented in its place. The upstream fault-injection scenario label is retained only as secondary metadata in case.json and was not used as packet evidence. baseline_confidence HIGH qualifies this sufficiency assessment, not a boundary verdict. The unverified legacy baseline_hash label was removed from this revision; the authoritative baseline digest is the canonical hash recorded as human_baseline_sha256 in differential.json. Previous canonical hash 02453f7e43b14f600cfce84c99672c12eac38dd0285a58fd8c2cad8ec1f0cd02.

scope_assessment.reason: N1 and N2 signaling is inside CoreNet scope; the abnormal boundary itself is not decodable from this capture

supporting_evidence.description: Registration accepted and initial UE context established
NGAP UplinkNASTransport (two coalesced PDUs, procedure code 46) carrying security-protected NAS messages with nas-5gs.security_header_type 2; the inner NAS content is not decodable
NGAP DownlinkNASTransport (procedure code 4) with nas-5gs.security_header_type 2; only nas-5gs.ciphered_msg is exposed, so no 5GSM message type and no cause are visible at this frame
Further NGAP DownlinkNASTransport (procedure code 4, security_header_type 2) inside the same protected exchange, so frame 18 is not the last network-side transfer
NGAP UplinkNASTransport retransmission (procedure code 46, security_header_type 2) carrying a security-protected NAS message; the retransmitted message type is not decodable
Final NGAP DownlinkNASTransport (procedure code 4, security_header_type 2) before the context release; inner NAS content is not decodable
NGAP UEContextReleaseRequest (procedure code 42) with Cause radioNetwork, radio-connection-with-ue-lost; a RAN-side transport observation whose core-side trigger is not decodable from this capture
